function.name: calculate_big_five_traits
function.description: Calculate the big five personality traits based on a set of questions answered by the user. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

answers.description: Answers to a set of questions rated on a scale from 1 to 5.

calculate_percentile.description: If true, the percentile rank for each trait will also be calculated.

average_answers.description: If true, answers will be averaged across each trait's questions.

message.content:
為了幫你了解自己的個性，我們可以先做一個簡短的「大五人格」測驗。請你根據以下每句話，評估自己在最近一段時間內的感受或行為，並以 **1 到 5** 的分數來回答（1 = 完全不符合，5 = 非常符合）：

| # | 問題 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 |
|---|------|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 我喜歡與陌生人交談。 | | | | | |
| 2 | 我經常感到焦慮或緊張。 | | | | | |
| 3 | 我喜歡嘗試新事物。 | | | | | |
| 4 | 我很容易被別人的情緒影響。 | | | | | |
| 5 | 我喜歡計畫和組織事情。 | | | | | |
| 6 | 我對自己的工作表現感到滿意。 | | | | | |
| 7 | 我喜歡與朋友一起參加社交活動。 | | | | | |
| 8 | 我經常感到沮喪或失落。 | | | | | |
| 9 | 我喜歡閱讀或學習新知識。 | | | | | |
|10 | 我喜歡挑戰自己，並且不怕失敗。 | | | | | |

請把每個問題的答案填寫在表格中，或直接列出 10 個數字（例如：`4, 2, 5, 1, 3, 4, 5, 2, 3, 5`）。完成後，我會幫你計算出各項人格特質的分數，並提供相應的百分位排名。祝你玩得開心！
message.reasoning: The user asks "我是什麼類型的個性？" which means "What type of personality am I?" They want to calculate big five traits. We need to ask them to answer some questions. The tool requires answers array. We can ask them to rate 10 or so questions. But we can also use the tool with no answers? No. We need to prompt them. So we should ask them to answer a set of questions. Provide a list of questions and ask them to rate each from 1 to 5. Then we can call the function. But we can't call the function until we have answers. So we need to ask them. So respond asking them to answer.
